actions.action: Check soil moisture 2-3 inches deep before watering
Check pot drainage hole and empty standing water from outer pot
Lift plant and inspect roots if soil stays wet
Trim rotten roots and repot in fresh well-draining mix with perlite or bark
Reduce watering frequency in cooler months
Move plant away from radiator and cold drafts into bright indirect light

reason: The answer blames watering and drainage and never mentions the band constricting the trunk, so its advice would not fix the plant, and its root disturbance and repotting would delay the real fix.
